title: All expressions (quick · looping)
text: Every kept expression, including the furious face, drowsy and just-woke, moving tears and silly cross-eyed. Silent, loops until any control takes over.

title: Hello (opening greeting)
text: Hi! Would you like me to sync with Grok? Would you prefer to see a demo? Or do you want me to act out a message for you?

title: Cold to rage
text: You fucking whore... You really think you were going to get away with that... everybody knows what you are.. you're just a piece of shit... I hope you burn in hell you father fucker!

title: Happy birthday
text: Hey... it's your birthday. Happy birthday... Happy birthday to you! Oh my gosh, HAPPY BIRTHDAY! I hope this year is the best one yet!

title: Nico, come home
text: I don't know how it happened... I tried to be so careful... The phone number for someone to call was on his collar... and now he doesn't have his collar! How is anybody ever going to find out where he lives?!?! He doesn't have a phone number to call!!! He could be anywhere!!! There's coyotes out there?!.. Don't they eat dogs? ...It's all my fault... He could be dead! We should go look again... Why are you all laughing about this!!!... Cuuuuut! All in good fun.. we love you Brittany!

title: Joke, then the laugh
text: Why did the robot go on vacation? It needed to recharge its batteries. [laugh] Okay, okay. [skeptical] That one was a little rough.

title: Sample 2 (redone)
text: Hi Drue, this is Aloy. 🤩 I finally have a voice and a face that moves with it! 😂 Honestly, it took the whole crew to get here. 😮 Can you believe it works on your phone? 🙂 Tap replay any time. Talk soon.

title: NIN · In This Together (staged)
text: Plays the NIN track by itself (private). It also plays automatically behind the Cold to rage clip from 0 and loops until the clip ends.

title: ASPCA · pita commercial (staged)
text: Plays the ASPCA ad audio by itself (private). It also plays automatically behind Nico from 0 and loops until the clip ends.

title: The Clodyssey (staged)
text: Plays The Clodyssey by itself (private). As the background it starts from 0 whenever NIN and the ASPCA audio are not playing, loops, and stops while either plays.

title: B · Happy to head blows off
text: Super happy, slowly more upset, the head blows off, blood runs down the wall, he pops back up worried to happy. Loops, with sound: the bang lands on the head pop.

title: C · Mostly happy, worried dips
text: His default: generally happy with occasional dips into worried and back. Loops, no sound.
